business_problem: With the ever-growing popularity of electronic messaging between patients and caregivers, US healthcare organization Providence faced a deluge of incoming messages. This flood required triage and interfered with the time providers needed to spend with their patients. Providence clinicians, informaticists, and AI specialists developed a new product, ProvARIA, based on Azure OpenAI Service.
solution_summary: Providence built this solution on Azure OpenAI Service. With the ever-growing popularity of electronic messaging between patients and caregivers, US healthcare organization Providence faced a deluge of incoming messages. Azure OpenAI Service provides the generative AI model layer used for summarization, drafting, classification, or copilots in the workflow. It was important to find a solution that meshed with the way Providence caregivers work, rather than creating a new set of tools that would require separate access and training. As third-party solutions did not fulfill that requirement, a team of Providence clinicians, informaticists, and AI specialists developed a new product, ProvARIA, based on Azure OpenAI Service. Messages, calls, or requests enter the existing workflow, Azure OpenAI Service classifies or summarizes them, and the reviewed output is surfaced to care teams inside the EHR workflow.
